_comment: Machine profile for the MLU workflow: DP training + LAMMPS exploration locally (deepmd-kit fork venv + fork-built lmp), QE labeling on the SLURM cluster. Adjust paths/partitions to your platform.

model_devi._comment_lmp: must be the LAMMPS built from the deepmd-kit fork (uparam/mlu_model keywords; see .devcontainer/build_cxx_mlu.sh)

fp._comment_remote: python3 with numpy must exist on the compute nodes (mlu_frame.py / uinit_loop.py run there)
